# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Desktop Editors

> Extend and customize ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors by integrating with document management systems.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. For the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/llms.txt).

## Get started

- [Overview](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/get-started/overview.md): ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors is an open-source office suite for working with documents stored on your computer. This application allows you to create, edit and view documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and fillable forms without constant connection to the Internet. Most popular formats are supported: DOCX, ODT, XLSX, ODS, CVS, PPTX, ODP, etc.
- [Encrypting local documents](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/get-started/how-it-works/encrypting-local-documents.md): To protect your local documents, spreadsheets and presentations, encrypt them with a simple symmetric encryption plugin. The steps below explain how to do it.
- [Encrypting cloud documents](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/get-started/how-it-works/encrypting-cloud-documents.md): Online editing and collaboration have the related gaps in file security - in real-time data transfer and authorized sharing. Overcoming these limitations of previously existing individual document protection is the key objective of the encryption scheme in question.

## API usage

- [Running Desktop Editors in debug mode](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/debugging.md): In certain cases, it is necessary to run ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors in debug mode — for example, to troubleshoot performance issues, inspect logs, or collect information for support.
- [Command-line flags](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/command-line-flags.md): ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors supports command-line flags that let you control how the application launches and behaves. Pass a flag by appending it to the executable path when starting the application.
- [Adding plugins](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-plugins.md): ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors allows developers to add specific features which are not directly related to the OOXML format using plugins. You can use ready-made plugins from the ONLYOFFICE Plugin Marketplace or create your own ones using our Plugins and macros API documentation.
- [Customizing themes](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/customizing-themes.md): You can create custom interface themes for ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors by adding JSON configuration files to the themes directory.
- [Adding a DMS provider](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider.md): ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors allows users to access the documents from the cloud and collaborate on them with their teammates. In this case, an Internet connection is required. Currently, users can connect the application to ONLYOFFICE DocSpace (SaaS or on-premises), Nextcloud, ownCloud, Moodle, Liferay, kDrive, or Seafile, but you can extend this list adding your own DMS.
- [Configuring the interaction](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/configuring-the-interaction.md): Once your DMS is added to the connection list, configure the DMS/Desktop Editors interaction:
- [Sending notifications](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/sending-notifications.md): The desktop app can send text messages to be displayed to the user. To do so, declare the function:
- [execCommand method](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/execcommand.md): Use the execCommand method of the window\.AscDesktopEditor object to execute a command specified in the request.
- [Login and logout](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/login-and-logout.md): Before you start working on documents stored within your cloud, you need to log in to it.
- [Opening documents](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/opening-documents.md): After registering in the cloud, you can start working on documents stored there.
- [Changing a theme](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/changing-a-theme.md): Starting from version 7.5, you can change a theme of the desktop editor tab. To do this, use the portal:uitheme command of the execCommand method.
- [Getting viewport settings](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/getting-viewport-settings.md): Starting from version 8.1, you can get the viewport settings of the desktop editors. This method is used to set the space between the top panel and the Desktop Editors widget.
- [Encryption](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/encryption.md): Starting from version 5.6, ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors offers support for Private Rooms, secure workspace where every symbol you type is encrypted end-to-end even if you co-edit documents in real time. Using ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors makes it possible to encrypt and decrypt the data on the client, ensuring endpoint security.
- [Key generation](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/encryption/key-generation.md): To check if the desktop app supports encryption, call the following command:
- [Operations with encrypted files](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/adding-a-dms-provider/encryption/operations-with-encrypted-files.md): To perform operations with encrypted files, including file encryption, decryption, creation, editing and sharing, ONLYOFFICE uses the individual credentials of users (RSA key pair) and a document password (document encryption key). The processes of uploading and sharing encrypted files are described here.
- [Connecting MCP servers](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/connecting-mcp-servers.md): ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors version 9.2 and later supports connecting MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to extend AI capabilities with custom tools and integrations. MCP allows AI agents to interact with various services and data sources through standardized protocols.
- [DocSpace MCP](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/desktop-editors/usage-api/connecting-mcp-servers/docspace-mcp.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace MCP server allows AI agents in Desktop Editors to interact with your DocSpace instance, enabling document management operations through natural language commands.
